text.card: A star about 93 parsecs away, 1.4 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.4 solar radii and 1.18 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,117 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 205739
quotes.card: HD 205739 is a yellow-white hued star in the southern constellation of Piscis Austrinus, positioned near the western constellation boundary with Microscopium.
quotes.introduction: It has the proper name Sāmaya, which was selected in the NameExoWorlds campaign by Sri Lanka, during the 100th anniversary of the IAU.
